title: Artifact reference
description: A reference to a stored artifact (ADR-0015 in the Acessilia core). The artifact's bytes are retrieved through the artifact API. digest always equals artifact_id; the Toolbox, the only producer, guarantees it, since Draft-07 cannot state equality between properties. scope and provenance come in reference@2.

artifact_id.description: Content-addressed identifier, always in canonical form: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex digits. Opaque to clients, stable and immutable.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the artifact's bytes, for clients to verify a download. Equal to artifact_id.

media_type.description: Media type of the artifact's bytes.

store.description: Kind of backend that served the reference (for example s3 or filesystem; never failover). It does not identify a deployment and is not used to route a download. null when the response claims no available, verified storage location: a result that was never stored, or a cache hit served inline while the store was unavailable. null is not proof that the artifact does not exist.
